# Fiscal position: fiscal-position (FISC)

Government debt and net lending (IMF) with revenue, expense and military spending (World Bank), as shares of GDP. One row per fiscal position, keyed by FISCAL_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `macro-store` (table `<root>/macro/fiscal-position/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/world-economy/samples/fiscal-position.jsonl`, 192 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/world-economy/samples/fiscal-position.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `FISCAL_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FISCAL_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^FISC-` | `"FISC-AFG"` |
| `ECONOMY_NAME` | string | required | The country or territory the figures describe. | — | `"Afghanistan"` |
| `YEAR` | string | optional (filled in 98% of rows) | The year of the figures. | seen: `2025`, `2024` | `"2025"` |
| `DEBT` | number | optional (filled in 98% of rows) | All liabilities of the general government that require payment of interest or principal, as a share of GDP (IMF). | unit: % of GDP | `8` |
| `BALANCE` | number | required | General government revenue minus total expenditure, as a share of GDP (IMF). | unit: % of GDP | `-0.9` |
| `REVENUE` | number | optional (filled in 78% of rows) | Central government revenue excluding grants, as a share of GDP (World Bank). | unit: % of GDP | `13.0393` |
| `SPENDING` | number | optional (filled in 78% of rows) | Central government cash payments for operating activities, as a share of GDP (World Bank). | unit: % of GDP | `39.2201` |
| `MILITARY` | number | optional (filled in 82% of rows) | All spending on the armed forces, as a share of GDP (SIPRI via the World Bank). | unit: % of GDP | `1.82793` |
| `RATIOS` | array of objects | required (filled in 93% of rows) | Central-government ratios of the latest year, one element per item (Tax revenue, Revenue (excl. grants), Expense, Military expenditure): ITEM and VALUE in % of GDP (World Bank); empty when none is published. | — | [4 objects] |
| `RATIOS[].ITEM` | string | required | The central-government item: Tax revenue, Revenue (excl. grants), Expense or Military expenditure. | one of `Expense`, `Military expenditure`, `Revenue (excl. grants)`, `Tax revenue` | `"Tax revenue"` |
| `RATIOS[].VALUE` | number | required | The item as a share of GDP. | unit: % of GDP | `9.89845` |
| `DEBT_PATH` | array of objects | required (filled in 98% of rows) | General government gross debt by year, one element per year: YEAR and DEBT in % of GDP (IMF WEO GGXWDG_NGDP; later years are projections). | — | [11 objects] |
| `DEBT_PATH[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the value, as four-digit text ("2015"). | — | `"2015"` |
| `DEBT_PATH[].DEBT` | number | required | General government gross debt in that year (IMF; later years are projections). | unit: % of GDP | `9.2` |
| `BALANCE_PATH` | array of objects | required | General government net lending (+) or borrowing (−) by year, one element per year: YEAR and BALANCE in % of GDP (IMF WEO GGXCNL_NGDP; later years are projections). | — | [11 objects] |
| `BALANCE_PATH[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the value, as four-digit text ("2015"). | — | `"2015"` |
| `BALANCE_PATH[].BALANCE` | number | required | General government balance in that year (IMF; later years are projections). | unit: % of GDP | `-1.4` |
| `ECONOMY` | string | required | The economy: an id of the economy kind (ECON-<ISO3>). | pattern `^ECON-`; links to `economy` | `"ECON-AFG"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (World Bank WDI, IMF WEO), DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation or organisations whose published data this view shows. | — | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators; International Mo…` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The named dataset and its vintage (the release the numbers come from). | — | `"World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08); World E…` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the data was downloaded by tools/realdata. | — | `"2026-10-10"` |

| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | — | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators; International Mo…` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 192 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `FISCAL_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `FISCAL_ID`, `ECONOMY_NAME`, `BALANCE`, `RATIOS`, `DEBT_PATH`, `BALANCE_PATH`, `ECONOMY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `FISCAL_ID` per snapshot.
- `FISCAL_ID` matches `^FISC-`.
